cues.text: Cover, frame one: 40 CALLS / 3 TRUCKS / WHO GOES FIRST? on a plate (EXAMPLE) over the dispatch board. At 0.6 s a blinds wipe to the weather map: the cold front sweeps in, snow, FIRST COLD NIGHT on the strip. On "Forty" a blinds wipe to the dispatch board: call pins drop fast, the counter runs to 40 NO-HEAT CALLS, three trucks wait in the yard (EXAMPLE). On "who" the question lands: WHO GETS A TECH FIRST?

The call queue: tickets in the order they rang (FIRST CALLED, FIRST SERVED). On "member" the gold MEMBER tickets jump to the top of the line with a kick; MEMBERS FIRST stamps on "first"; on "every month" a coin icon on each gold ticket.

The send card, held still: FOR WHOEVER DOES YOUR BOOKS / THE MEMBER PLAN / 1 TWO TUNE-UPS A YEAR / 2 MEMBERS FIRST WHEN IT BREAKS / 3 A DISCOUNT ON EVERY REPAIR / 4 ONE PRICE, BILLED MONTHLY, tagged EXAMPLE: OUR SUGGESTED PLAN. Each step's marker lights on its words.

The ACHR News line on a card, typed on: "Per the survey, 87% of homeowners are willing to pay either $100 or $200 annually for a service agreement." with its tag (The ACHR News with Clear Seas Research, Dec 2023; read Nov 8, 2026). On "eighty-seven" a four-step fade to the hero: 87% (data.js) over a grid of 100 houses, 87 lit, WOULD PAY $100 OR $200 A YEAR / FOR A SERVICE AGREEMENT under it, the source line on top.
Twelve month boxes in a row; a coin drops into each in turn (EXAMPLE), the slow months included; SLOW WEEKS TOO lands on "slow", the phone on the shelf sits silent.
The dispatch board again: the first truck's route draws to the gold member pin; FIRST TRUCK: MEMBER stamps on "first truck" (EXAMPLE). Holds to the end card.
